body: on this day in 2010: "mine" leaked early, so taylor just shipped it early. the speak now lead single was set for aug 16 -- an unauthorized leak pushed big machine to rush it to radio + itunes on aug 4, twelve days ahead of plan. it debuted at no. 3 on the hot 100 with 297k downloads anyway. sometimes the plan breaks and it works out better.
why: X-native version of the on-this-day 'Mine' rush-release item, shipping on the real Aug. 4 anniversary. Same vault sourcing as the IG pair (Speak Now 'vault-speak-now-mine-leaks-so-the-label-ships-it-12-days-early', Billboard/Wikipedia/CBS): the Aug. 16 planned date, the early leak, Big Machine rushing 'Mine' to radio + iTunes on Aug. 4 twelve days early, and the No. 3 Hot 100 debut with 297,000 downloads. Chart-lore only, outside every blocklist topic. Text-only (no media).
